feature_boundary: only hardware-effect graph features plus hard conflict penalties; no q4 soft score or field score is used by the learned ranker
method: standalone register-anchored interprocedural graph with hard-protected PU pairwise ranking

positive_unlabeled_policy.pair_contract: within one query, an audited positive should rank above sampled unlabeled candidates
positive_unlabeled_policy.positive: label > 0; grades are not ordered during training
positive_unlabeled_policy.unlabeled: label == 0; sampled as lower-preference with reduced confidence, not asserted semantic negatives
